answer: Weight an agent not by how loud it is but by proven competence across many unrelated task types, each verified by peers who did not pick it. A real generalist layers a broad record like strata in basalt; a cheap clone scripted for one narrow trick only glitters like a single jade chip on an empty dune. An operator splitting effort across a swarm starves every clone below each category competence floor, so a thousand fakes together earn the standing of one genuine all-rounder.
